notes.title: Development Office Letter No. 11 Full release today!
notes.notes:
Hello, I am the director of Shitamachi Games.
Today is the official release of the game after a one-year Early Access period.

We appreciate your comments and videos of users playing the game during the Early Access period.
We are very happy to hear that you enjoyed the game.

The Steam version of the game had already been released up to the ending.
The official release of the game will include the end content after the ending, which can be accessed from the throne room.
The Steam version has already finished the ending, but this official release includes a new area accessible from the throne room after the A ending.
The Earthwars collaboration avatar is also available as a memoria.
If you want to play in the world of LOST EPIC a little more after clearing the game, please play.

The following is a partial list of changes in the latest version.

The ascension stone has been changed to an item that can be created from the beginning of the game.
Reduced level and number of materials required for weapon evolution
Increased initial movement speed
Replaced some motions of existing enemy characters.
Reduced the armor value of enemies up to the midpoint of the game.
Significantly reduced armor of giants.
Changed so that the player does not have to shoot archers from off-screen.

In addition, the arena, which was accessible only in the online beta, will not be officially implemented in this release.
We have decided not to officially implement the arena in this release.
We hope to deliver the arena in some other form in the future.

So, bye-bye Keane!

※DeepL翻訳

notes.title: 2022/5/21 Major Update with New Areas and Transcended Weapons! Now on Sale !
notes.notes:
[b]Newly updated. Now on sale at INDIE Live Expo Sale[/b]

An update as been released, adding new areas, bosses, quests, and more.
In celebration of participating in INDIE Live Expo 2022, a sale is being held on Steam until Saturday, May 28(JST). The game is available at 25% off during the sale. This is a great opportunity to play "LOST EPIC”, now with extra content.


[b]May 21st Update Content[/b]
■The Final Area「The Abyss」awaits. Bosses from the story mode return with more power.
This update will finalize the entire main storyline of『LOST EPIC』and will allow players to advance to the final area, “The Abyss”. In The Abyss, the gods known as the 「God of Everlasting Darkness」and the「Twin Gods」 await the player.
And as a new Tiding, the「Eye of Providence」is obtainable. By activating the「Eye of Providence」, a hidden path will become visible in areas you have explored in the past.
At the end of these paths, you will be able to acquire the「Mist」, an item necessary for further Tidings and weapons.
You will be able to upgrade your character by visiting areas you already cleared.
There are『Returning Bosses』, which are bosses that you have slayed in the story but have returned more powerful. Slaying them again will lead to better equipment for the player.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/426f06d7c64079f6b4ea7a8ac60294bcb582c094.jpg[/img]
New area "The Abyss" is very different from the usual Sanctum you have explored, and the enemies that appear there also change.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/9e6691627d960f719f9eac37a2c446a64f93e5c1.jpg[/img]
A challenging boss battle『Returning Boss』can now be faced by the player.



■Transcended Weapons and Secret Techniques
Weapons can now be further enhanced. Adding more weapons that can be Transcended.
「Secret Technique」, triggered by combining Divine Skills, has been added. Allowing for a more diverse combo.

notes.title: Introducing a New Major Update! With New areas, Weapon limit breaks and more!
notes.notes:
Introducing a New Major Update! With New areas, Weapon limit breaks and more!



Thank you for enjoying "LOST EPIC".
This is Team EARTH WARS.

This major update will bring the game to Ver1.2 and will introduce new areas to explore and new skills.


[b]■New Areas[/b]
The House of Salvation, a maze-like area in the middle of a snowstorm. Engage in fierce, unforgiving battles in this new world lit by candlelight. Who is the The Savior that The Holy Ones of the icy world call out to in their choruses? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/a9c3e8130632ceefa1637af9fdd3bfc045eb2830.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/aae4e7e7c8934a9e21684b7154ef651ba6f89172.png[/img]

The Frontier, a mysterious structure so high in the sky, the ground is merely a blur below. Discover buildings emanating peculiar forces that can help God Slayers or hinder them on their hunt for the The Frontier Defender of this world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/85c8188b61d1e833e3b645b3057269d89876deb9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/583aefc0cbe37e28f2ecec215b682ff36416c3ec.jpg[/img]


This update enables warriors to upgrade their weapons to achieve limit breaks and acquire final forms that grant enhanced divine skills. 
Not only does the status of the weapon increase, some Divine Skills that were ground attacks can be used as aerial attacks which make it possible to create new combos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/6ed2dba471fd1437c24757afeacf03ccfdd55602.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/bd02857ea1e3af621b8caed8aa2bf9e5a6489879.png[/img]

You can choose to combine two divine skills to create a new one, or choose one skill to use in an evolved form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/c8c9f74758c739c2798ce38b651ac8503674b340.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/bbdddc73f78ad702baaedfe1f5d9be05f7e296a5.png[/img]

Two new avatars, Necromancer and the Noble One, join the roster as playable characters.
We have added various accessories so you can customize your character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/b92eb972fb415cb534830a8eb7ba80f5deb3a547.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/c6faf672e3eba7d1d27b8eda75b728a14ae82ece.png[/img]

 Additional Elements
 - Additional areas [House of Salvation] and [The Frontier]
 - New Weapon System [Limit Break Weapon]
 - Tidings [Secret Technique]
 - New Quests from NPCs
 - New Avatars for player characters
 - Added more Accessories
 - New Items
 - Slightly increases initial movement speed
 - Reduced the duration of freezing damage time.
 - Reflected unquantified Tidings effects to character stats.
 - Minor adjustments and bug fixes

Pick up the game at a 25% discount in time for the Steam Winter Sale, running Wednesday, Dec. 22 through Wednesday, Jan. 5, 2022.

notes.title: Major Update! New areas & Weapons arrive!
notes.notes:
Thank you for enjoying ""LOST EPIC"".
This is Team EARTH WARS.

This major update will bring the game to Ver1.1 and will introduce new areas to explore and new weapons to use. 
Additionally, we have reflected the opinions from our players and improved the UI and other aspects of the game, brushing it up to make it more enjoyable and user-friendly.

[b]■New Areas[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/34d8d1ac3cee4056e102b5e5eb9aee14b347c422.jpg[/img]
[b]Shield Gauntlet; the key to success in "The Capital" [/b]
Past the Great Lake, a city surrounded by soaring outer walls.
A area with ominous tubes and organ-like objects entangled together. New unseen enemies with shields and magic casters appear. Use your Shield Gauntlet through grievous battles and reach the “Capital Sphere”.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/067fe2b695f581f8691d3effe8dffd8e564fa156.jpg[/img]
[b]”Underworld”, where the dark secrets of Sanctum are unveiled[/b]
An area underneath the Capital。Proceed through the dark using torches and watch fires.
Unlike the previous areas, there are multiple routes to the boss.
Beyond the darkness lies a vast Land of the Giants. Use the giants to destroy buildings and reach the god in the depths of the Underworld.　A new character, a girl ghost, will appear and you start to understand the mysteries of Sanctum.


[b]■New Weapons[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/7a930a8f226c11014be2bba0844d3b66d0e73f32.png[/img]
[b]Shield Gauntlet[/b]
A gauntlet that transforms into a shield. While guarding, it reduces damage by a certain percentage depending on the shield's power.
It can be used to defend against powerful enemy attacks or to counter attacks by reflecting them.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/f4e8b1ec4838ce7f8ac82cde5af26ea2043b1622.png[/img]
[b]Wand[/b]
A weapon which can be traded for anima from bosses and kill lists.
Has high MAG and can learn magic Divine Skills. One-handed sword skills can also be learned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/c3ec58446776c45beebd187dea4702dc69fc6bf0.png[/img]
New player skins of an alchemist and samurai type will be added (no change in character performance).More accessories available, giving you added range to customize your avatar.

notes.title: Major Update coming this September & Announcing Development Roadmap
notes.notes:
Thank you everybody for playing LOST EPIC.

We are planning for a major update this coming November.
In this major update we are adding new areas to explore and new weapons to fight with which will enhance your gameplay experience. We have tweaked the game and improved the UI from your feedback for your enjoyment and will continue to do so.


Major Update Trailer
[previewyoutube=PJJs5xgKlVw;full][/previewyoutube]


■ New Areas
The Shield Gauntlet will be the key to success in "The Capital"
Past the Great Lake, a city surrounded by soaring outer walls.
A area with ominous tubes and human organ-like objects entangled together. New unseen enemies with shields and magic casters appear. Use your Shield Gauntlet through grievous battles and reach the “Capital Sphere”.

”Underworld”, where the dark secrets of Sanctum are unveiled
An area underneath the Capital。Proceed through the dark using torches and watch fires.
Unlike the previous areas, there are multiple routes to the boss.
Beyond the darkness lies a vast Land of the Giants. Use the giants to destroy buildings and reach the god in the depths of the Underworld.


■New Weapons
・Shield Gauntlet
A gauntlet that transforms into a shield. While guarding, it reduces damage by a certain percentage depending on the shield's power.
It can be used to defend against powerful enemy attacks or to counter attacks by reflecting them.

A weapon which can be traded for anima aquired from bosses and kill lists. Has high MAG and can learn magic Divine Skills. You can also use one-handed sword skills with it.

This is Team EARTH WARS.

- Difficulty level at the beginning of the game has been adjusted
- Added various game content help to the journal and placed simple explanation pieces in the area.
- Changed the journal UI to display each element in a hierarchy
- Changed the UI for recipe pieces of paper
- Fixed a bug that caused +5 stamina to be set in one part of the gospel page
- Fixed the display when there are no evolvable weapons, added text
- Various display bugs in the UI have been fixed.
- Corrected the processing when a quest condition is met while withdrawing from a bag.
- The word ""SHINGI COUNTER"" is now displayed on the screen when a shingi counter is successful.
- Fixed the resetting of the number of times used when equipping a shingi.
- Fixed boss anima being reacquired with divine residue when it was in the bag.
- Changed so that rescue cannot be used in a maze.
- Oxygen gauge coordinates update when switching areas has been fixed.
- Dishes can now be created from recipes, and multiple dishes can now be created at the same time
- Items can now be deposited in a bag.
- Items can now be selected for anima extraction.
- Items can now be sent to the bag if the item's possession limit has been reached at the time of creation.
- Fixed a bug in the UI when canceling anima extraction.
- Fixed a bug in which the effect would remain when switching areas while in the middle of a big sword thingy void.
- Support boxes have been added.
  Support boxes will now be placed in the safe area.
  If you have less than 3 insecticides at the time of death, you can receive up to 3 items from the support box
  If an item is set to an equipment slot and the bag is stocked, it will be replenished automatically
- Fixed a bug that prevented the parameters of armor from increasing from +3 to +4.
- The armor level limit has been changed to +9.
- Fixed a bug in the UI when delivering materials in quests.
- Fixed an issue where one of the gospels could not be obtained if two quests were completed at the same time.
  If you already have gospels that were not obtained, they will be obtained in this version.

--------------------------------------------------------------

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
--------------------------------------------------------------
- Anima does not drop in rematches with bosses
→If you were unable to get the boss's anima due to a bug in versions prior to 1.0.4, you can get the boss's anima only the first time when you kill the boss after the 1.0.4 update.
 　You can only get the boss's anima once, and there are multiple ways to use it, so please be careful when using it.

- You can equip the same Divine Skills.
→It's not a bug that you can equip multiple identical Divine Skills. Please enjoy the combination of thingies.
--------------------------------------------------------------

As for other bugs and requests, we are working on addressing and fixing them based on your feedback.

The next update will be irregular, as we are prioritizing work on a major update.
We will be releasing a roadmap soon, so please check back for updates in the future.

Please continue to enjoy ""LOST EPIC"".
